snippets.snippet: Village of Magnetic Springs Zoning Regulation APP - 24 Village of Magnetic Springs Application for Certificate of Zoning Compliance Before any building may be occupied or use of land utilized, it is necessary for the zoning officer to certify that the construction/use is in accordance with the zoning ordinance and the previously approved Application for Zoning Permit. Approximately one week prior to the completion of construction, mail this form to the zoning officer. If the construction was completed in accordance with the approved Zoning Permit, he/she will approve the Certificate of Zoning Compliance and return it to the applicant ad dress below via Certified Mail. Temporary Certificate of Zoning Compliance may be issued for a period not to exceed 6 months.
